name: Rim Frontier
description: The outer reaches are hard to reach and hold: an ion-storm belt, thinning stars, gravity shoals that pull ships out of hyperspace, little fuel and poor sensor coverage. Stacks with The Rim Trade.

flags.name: rimFrontier
flags.label: Rim frontier geography
flags.description: Storm belt, sparser rim, gravity shoals, inward fuel, rim sensor fog and the map-scale options below.

params.name: rimFrontierBeltInner
params.label: Storm belt / fog inner radius (fraction of the galaxy radius)

params.name: rimFrontierThinFactor
params.label: Share of star positions rejected past the thinning radius

params.name: rimFrontierFuelMaxRadius
params.label: Fuel bias: Caslon / Hydrogen only inside this radius (fraction; 1.5 = off)

params.name: rimFrontierFogFactor
params.label: Rim sensor range multiplier (ship sensors; listening posts exempt)

params.name: rimFrontierExtent
params.label: Galaxy extent multiplier (same stars spread wider)

params.name: rimFrontierStarCount
params.label: Star count override (0 = the wizard's; up to the raised cap)
